scope: administrative input binding; observed during verification preparation, not retroactive execution telemetry
limitations: File identities are necessary input bindings, not complete Rust binary/build custody or proof of test reuse
Nix flake/lock and Cargo/toolchain/config identities bind declared build dependencies; prior executable bytes are not inferred
Frozen Git context reads bind exact revisions and per-file hashes in context-before/after reports
Accountable dependency and impact review remains required
